n53e9056adb.headline: [CONSULTING ROOMS] Is there pressure from workers to receive their salary payment in foreign currency?
n53e9056adb.summary: Although Venezuelan labor law states salaries must be paid in bolívar, it is possible to pay wages in foreign currency, reflecting economic realities.
n53e9056adb.why: Currency instability in Venezuela leads to widespread use of foreign currencies, affecting labor markets and inflation dynamics.
